display_name: 有标签困难样本指导的独立 IQ 恢复
description: 固定 Tri-SIG-TIME SSL，直接恢复网络采用合法训练划分 L_s 真值和高置信干净教师伪标签，并加权当前受损信号识别错误的训练样本；不依赖 DURA。
authorization: 用户要求大胆研发 Phase1 恢复网络，不拘泥 DURA，地面基座 Tri-SIG-TIME SSL；不使用 Phase3。

code.environment: N607 CVS-RFFI Python GPU 2 if idle; two CPU threads

data.version: original7/63/30 Phase1 source physical ID contract
data.representation: float32 IQ [2,256]; source L_s/U_s paired clean and simulated post_sync residual channel
data.label_map_ref: Frozen Tri-SIG-TIME SSL source contract, six classes
data.tx_sets_ref: Six Phase1 TX; actual L_s metadata read and validated; only L_s labels in training split used; no U_s labels
data.validation_ref: 4096 fixed sampled L_s/U_s IDs; rx4/6 day3 validation and rx8 day3 exploratory heldout; all three receiver/day groups excluded from training. L_s metadata includes all source IDs but nontraining labels discarded before optimization; no V
data.leo_config_ref: Fixed source cache epochs 16–19 training, epoch20 validation, seven Phase1 practical scenes

permissions.query_use: No target data until all source selection fixed; then seven-view predictions before truth; no Phase3
permissions.claim_scope: Single seed, source heldout and Phase1 development previously observed, no independent-blind or real satellite claim

checkpoint.initialization: Fixed direct IQ source parent epoch10; Tri-SIG-TIME SSL frozen; DURA never used during training or inference
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: core.data checks physical IDs against Tri-SIG-TIME roles; parent commit exact
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Frozen designated Phase1 source contract; previous Phase1 development results observed, no clean-blind claim
checkpoint.selection_rule: RX4/6 day3 source clean F high-confidence pseudo targets and paired IQ, epochs1/2/4 alpha .25/.5/1; per-cell classification and IQ guard, >=2 impaired net gain; raw fallback; RX8 excluded from selection

execution.gpu_policy: GPU2 only if idle; one worker, two CPU threads

TX RX day on post-prediction scorer

notes: All 6300 L_s metadata records loaded only to validate provenance; labels retained for training IDs only. No U_s ground truth, V or target IQ/labels.
Frozen clean F pseudo targets used for source selection; no TX truth used for source selection.
DURA is not a model input or architecture; optional post-freeze matched comparator only.
RX8 source holdout and target development results previously observed, so all results exploratory nonblind.
